venues.parkingDetail: The University of New Mexico owns and controls most of the parking lots surrounding Rio Grande Credit Union Field at Isotopes Park. Fans are charged $7.00 to park in the surrounding UNM lots. Vehicles with four or more people are allowed to park in the Stadium East Lot for free. Vehicles displaying a disabled permit or placard are allowed to park for free at the UNM East Lot. There is a limited number of disabled parking spaces available on a first-come, first-served basis in Lots A and C. If Lots A or C are full, overflow disabled parking is also available at the Stadium West Lot on a first-come, first-served basis.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is reserved for guests with accessible requirements and their companions. Guests requiring accessible seating may purchase one (1) accessible seat and up to three (3) companion seats adjacent to the accessible seat. Depending upon availability, seats for additional guests will be located as close as possible to the accessible space. Isotopes Park is committed to working with guests on a case-by-case basis to adequately accommodate individual needs. All ticket sales are based on availability. Isotopes Park is fully accessible. Guests may enter Isotopes Park at any of the entry gates. Ramps are provided at all entries, and there are elevators that will take patrons to the Club or Suite Level if they choose those seats. For questions regarding accessible seating, please contact the Isotopes Park Box Office at (505) 222-4058.

generalInfo.generalRule: To help ensure everyone's safety, Isotopes Park has a no reentry policy. Guests who wish to exit and reenter the facility for personal emergencies should be directed to the Guest Services Booth. Reentry accommodations are up to the discretion of the Albuquerque Isotopes and are strictly limited to emergencies only. Isotopes Park is a non smoking facility. No outside food and beverage is allowed (with the exception of sealed bottles of water). The Isotopes do not allow laser pointers, noisemakers, fireworks, weapons or any other item that may be considered dangerous or may interfere with enjoyment of the game for another fan. Please check the Isotopes A to Z Guide at www.abqisotopes.com for additional information regarding prohibited items and bag policy. Gates will open one (1) hour prior to the start of the game unless otherwise noted. Please check www.abqisotopes.com or call (505) 924 2255 (BALL) for updated gate times. Isotopes tickets are the property of the Albuquerque Isotopes and may not be sold or distributed on property grounds. Attempted or actual resale or distribution of tickets at any price is prohibited. Isotopes management reserves the right to confiscate any tickets being sold or distributed. Please note that the protective netting has been extended to cover Sections 101 through 123 and 102 through 124. RGCU Field at Isotopes Park is a clear bag only facility. Each fan may carry one bag of any size that is clear plastic, vinyl or PVC. No purses or other bags will be permitted in the ballpark. For guests with medical or childcare needs such as diapers, wipes, formula, bottles or breast pumps, those items must be brought in a medical or diaper bag and those bags are subject to search upon entry into the stadium. Only childcare or medical items may be carried inside of these bags, all other personal items must be carried in an approved clear bag. Please check the Isotopes A to Z Guide at www.abqisotopes.com for additional information regarding prohibited items and bag policy. Seating Policy Guests should sit only in the seats for which they hold valid tickets. Guests may be asked to show their ticket stub if there is confusion over a specific seat.

Vehicles displaying a disabled permit or placard are allowed to park for free at the UNM East Lot. There is a limited number of disabled parking spaces available on a first-come, first-served basis in Lots A and C. Guests may enter Isotopes Park at any of the entry gates. Ramps are provided at all entries, and there are elevators that will take patrons to the Club or Suite Level if they choose those seats. For questions regarding accessible seating, please contact the Isotopes Park Box Office at (505) 222-4058.

Please check the Isotopes A to Z Guide at www.abqisotopes.com for additional information regarding prohibited items and bag policy. venues.parkingDetail: General Parking Guidelines •General Parking - General parking is included in the price of your ticket. The parking lots typically open 2 hours prior to the stated show time. •Accessible Parking - Accessible Parking is located in the southwest corner of the upper parking lot or in the lower level lot (very limited.) •Motorcycle Parking - Motorcycles can park in the upper parking lot in the southwest corner. There is no additional fee for motorcycle parking. •Premier Parking - Can be purchased on our upgrades page or at the entrance to the Premier Parking lot. Premier Parking can only be purchased with credit card - cash is not accepted. •Ultra Premier - Can be purchased on our upgrades page or at the entrance to the Ultra Premier Lot. Parking can only be purchased with credit card - cash is not accepted. •Easy Out - Enjoy expedited exit from the venue! Can be purchased on our upgrades page or at the entrance of the lot - Parking can only be purchased with credit card - cash is not accepted. •VIP Parking - located in the lower lot by the VIP entrance. Limited overflow parking is available in the main level lot. Season ticket holders must have parking credentials displayed. TAILGATING IS NOT PERMITTED IN THE VENUE PARKING LOTS. Fans will be ticketed if caught tailgating in any of the venue parking lots. There is no overnight parking permitted at the venue. Any unauthorized vehicles on site prior to an event, or after, will be towed at the owner's expense.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available at almost every price level & assistive listening devices are available. Companion seats are available up to applicable ticket limit. First Financial Credit Union Amphitheater strives to make our venue and live experiences inclusive and accessible to everyone.
